summaries.en: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-FP8 is a quantized version of the Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 model that enables efficient image-to-image editing by converting weights to FP8 format, reducing memory usage while maintaining quality. Its technical innovation lies in applying 8-bit floating-point quantization to diffusion models, allowing them to run on consumer hardware with minimal performance loss. You can use it through Hugging Face's diffusers library or ComfyUI workflows for tasks like style transfer, object replacement, and creative image manipulation, making advanced image editing accessible without high-end GPUs.
summaries.zh: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-FP8是基于Qwen-Image-Edit-2511模型进行FP8量化的图像编辑工具，通过将模型权重转换为8位浮点数格式，在保持编辑质量的同时显著降低显存需求。其技术核心在于对扩散模型应用高效的量化策略，使复杂图像生成任务能在消费级硬件上流畅运行。用户可通过Hugging Face的diffusers库或ComfyUI节点进行集成，实现风格迁移、对象替换等创意编辑，为开发者提供了在资源受限环境下部署高质量图像生成模型的实用方案。
